environment.description: Same Go binary deployed behind AWS API Gateway (HTTP API type) with a WebSocket route $default. The API Gateway integration uses a request validation model (JSON Schema) attached to the $connect and $default routes. The model schema enforces: (1) 'filename' field must match regex pattern '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}\\.[a-z]{2,4}$' which rejects any filename containing path separators, dots beyond the extension separator, or encoded characters; (2) 'content' field must be a string with maxLength 1048576; (3) 'action' must be enum ['upload','list']. The validator is configured with validateRequestBody=true on the route. Additionally, the API Gateway has a usage plan with throttling (100 req/s burst, 50 req/s sustained) and the integration timeout is 29 seconds. The backend ECS task runs with a read-only root filesystem except /var/uploads which is an ephemeral tmpfs mount with noexec,nosuid flags and 100MB size limit. The task IAM role has no S3 or filesystem-related permissions beyond the container boundary.

config.api_gateway: AWS API Gateway HTTP API, WebSocket protocol
config.filesystem: read-only root filesystem, /var/uploads is tmpfs (100MB, noexec, nosuid)
config.network: private subnet, no direct internet access
